---
title: Measles
lang: en
---
Measles is a highly contagious disease caused by the measles virus. It spreads through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes.

## Signs and symptoms

Symptoms usually develop 10 to 12 days after exposure and include fever, cough, runny nose and red eyes. A red, flat rash usually starts on the face.

## Prevention

The MMR vaccine is safe and effective. Two doses are about 97% effective at preventing measles.
